name: machine_brick
retail_behavior: State 0: select brick, cancel delete mode, preview direct machine WAV, enter state 1, kick machine animation if idle. State 1: same type toggles off; different type changes cursor/type and previews WAV without kicking animation.

name: composition_wall
retail_behavior: State 0: owner-aware pickup/delete of occupied event; delete mode removes and latches interaction. State 1: place into empty cell, replace occupied event and pick removed type up, restore removed event if replacement cannot fit; continuation cells are not owner-resolved in state 1.

name: secondary_stop_or_cursor_normalize
retail_behavior: State 0 delete mode: restores normal cursor without clearing delete flag. State 9: always draws mpstopred.bmp at (260,416); click stops/resets backing track and returns to state 0.

name: legacy_play_region
retail_behavior: Hit-table record (340,415)-(395,463); no state-0/state-1 editor dispatch effect and ignored by the state-9 secondary hit path in this retail build.

name: Play
retail_behavior: Strict rect (324,416)-(378,472). Edit-state only, delete mode off. Sets play-pending, StopAll managed sounds, action voice base+1 priority50 flag1. State 8 begins only after managed audio becomes idle.

name: Stop
retail_behavior: Strict rect (260,416)-(314,472). Playing-state only, delete mode off. Stops backing track, returns state 0, plays base+3+rand()%2 priority50 flag1.

name: ClearAll
retail_behavior: Strict rect (103,416)-(157,472). Edit-state only, delete mode off. Opens data\\ui\\Deletebricks.bmp using Yes/No confirmation context 2. Nonzero confirmation result clears all 120 cells to -1.

name: Delete
retail_behavior: Strict rect (481,416)-(535,472). Edit-state only. Toggles delete mode/cursor; entering plays base+9+rand()%2 priority50 flag1, leaving restores normal cursor.

name: Play_hover
retail_behavior: First hover after another control/no control plays base+6 priority50 flag2.

name: Stop_hover
retail_behavior: First hover after another control/no control plays base+7 priority50 flag2.

name: ClearAll_hover
retail_behavior: First hover after another control/no control plays base+8 priority50 flag2.

name: Delete_hover
retail_behavior: First hover after another control/no control plays base+9 priority50 flag2.
